youtube.title: Why Zebras Have Stripes 🦓 #Shorts
youtube.description:
A zebra's stripes probably aren't camouflage. When researchers dressed horses in striped coats, biting flies approached but mostly failed to land: the stripes seem to confuse how flies judge their approach. In Africa those flies spread deadly diseases, so the stripes are most likely a bug shield.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
